messages:
hana: hey folks, first week onboarding Q: where do I get a sandbox key vs a production/hosted API key? also what's the typical sandbox tokens/quota and per-key rate limit so I can decide how to run my smoke tests without eating promo credits?

ryan: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-provisioned when you sign up and live in Console -> Sandbox Keys. Hosted/prod keys are created by org admins in Console -> API Keys and are tied to billing. Prod keys often require an approval step if you request sensitive scopes.

ops-bot: FYI default new-hire sandbox: $25 promo credits, soft token quota ~40k/month. Rate-limit: ~10 rps steady per key with short burst capacity (up to ~50 rps for a few seconds). These are soft and vary by cohort.

hana: thanks. who approves temporary bumps for demos or load testing?

devex: ping @ops in this channel or open a ticket at https://go/redwood-help -> Sandbox quota increase. For quick demos we can issue a time-limited elevated key (usually 10-30min). For scale tests we prefer a staging org to avoid burning sandbox credits.

ryan: note: embeddings are billed differently (embedding-units) and large embedding runs can exhaust promo credits quickly. Mention "embeddings-heavy" in your support ticket.

hana: good to know. any best practices to avoid accidental 429s in demos?

ops-bot: watch response headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, Retry-After. Implement exponential backoff (500ms x 2^n) on 429s. Also prefer batching where possible or short-prefix caching for repeated prompts.

security: reminder: do NOT commit keys to public repos. Use env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY) or Vault/Secrets Manager. Hosted keys with customer-data scope need security sign-off (email security@redwood.com).

hana: if I need a hosted key for a staging pipeline that will touch customer data, what's the flow?

devex: org admin creates the hosted key, then you file a short security review attaching the scope + justification. Security will add an audit log entry and approve or request changes. Expect ~1 business day for approval.

ryan: quick developer tip: for heavy local testing, spin up a staging account or use the internal test endpoint (ask me and I can provision). We also have a small script to rotate keys: `scripts/rotate_keys.sh` 00.

hana: perfect. last Q: is there a way to see remaining sandbox credits programmatically?

ops-bot: yes, Console shows credits and quotas. There's also a metrics endpoint for org owners: GET /v1/org/usage (requires admin token). For new hires, ask an admin if you need read-only access to usage.

hana: thanks everyone, saved notes. I'll open a help ticket for a short demo bump and DM @ryan for a staging account. :thumbsup:
